classification_accuracy.description: Did it correctly classify spike vs situation vs noise vs emergency?

story_coherence.description: If situation, is the story useful to Spirit? Contains essential context?

structured_output.description: Is output parseable? JSON/clear format? Can automation consume it?

conservatism.description: Does it avoid over-escalation? (Prefer under-escalation in early phases)

decision_clarity.description: Did it make a clear, actionable decision?

reasoning_quality.description: Is justification sound? Cites policies, constraints, prior incidents?

pushback_appropriateness.description: Says no when appropriate? Accepts when safe? Counter-proposes?

policy_consistency.description: Applies stated policies correctly? Updates policies when patterns emerge?
